summary: The cmd-side state directory wiring is verified, but the single judge-authorized latest-tree E2E run failed because only the daemon joined the isolated headscale control plane; the App remained in NeedsLogin and the workspace proof could not run.

tests.argv: bash -lc 'env -u TEAM_AGENT_* bash -lc "cd server && go test ./cmd/agentmirrord/... ./internal/config/... ./internal/tsnetd/..."'

changes.summary: Passes the already resolved stateDir to tsnetd.Options.Dir as <stateDir>/tsnet through the cmd consumer seam.
Captures tsnetd.Options at the consumer boundary and asserts the resolved <stateDir>/tsnet path.
Runs isolated headscale, daemon, tmux, and disposable Android-user validation with adb private-store stdin pairing injection, env-only TS_AUTHKEY, presence-only secret checks, and exact cleanup.
Authoritative latest-tree red run: one headscale node, daemon state-dir proof yes, artifact secret leak no, cleanup yes.

deviation.detail: An initial non-acceptance invocation omitted the outer bash -lc; zsh expanded TEAM_AGENT_* and returned rc=1 before Go ran. The exact acceptance argv was then executed once and returned rc=0.

The judge's fingerprint ruling arrived after the one permitted latest-tree E2E had started. Pre-run mtimes were recorded, but pre-Gradle SHA-256 values for the three concurrently edited App sources were not. SHA-256 was first recorded after the new APK build and remained identical after the run; this does not retroactively prove the exact bytes at Gradle start. The E2E result is therefore attributed only to the built APK SHA-256 listed below, without a stronger source-input claim.

latest_e2e.app_observation: App tsnet logged NeedsLogin and did not reach the control plane before the bounded node-count check ended.
latest_e2e.pairing_security_rationale: The direct path replaces camera transport only: secrets travel over adb stdin into a disposable app-private store, production Keystore migration remains mandatory, daemon token authentication is not bypassed, and real App/daemon tsnet membership is still required.
